slots.source.static_rules: SDK · IaC · endpoint usage → platform role. A source kind decides whether an S3-compatible call is a cloud dependency.
slots.source.exit_scope: residual-dependency block list for the exit drill, scoped so a same-kind target is not blocked.
slots.target.catalog: role → target implementation, grade, verification, capability.
slots.target.neutral_apply: neutral model → target object exposure and secret delivery.
slots.target.rehearsal: isolated rehearsal profile, credential job and bucket job on the target.
slots.target.build: stack that builds the target with the common base (Kubernetes, CNPG, PgBouncer, Tailscale operator, cloudflared).
slots.both.control_probes: (kind, test_id) → probe for the control tests that are not kind-neutral.
slots.both.identity: read-only identity and connectivity check at registration.

same_kind: allowed when the two environments differ in cluster identity and database identity
